method: Single-rater (assistant) semantic-plausibility check against the 5 reference answers per question. NOT the originally-scoped 300-500-sample / 2-annotator / Cohen's-kappa protocol -- no image access, no second rater, no inter-rater agreement statistic. Authorized by user as a substitute given no annotator time before the deadline (2026-09-05: "human thi m tu check luon di").

labels.correct: prediction matches the intended meaning of at least one reference, even if phrased differently
labels.partial: prediction is plausible and addresses the question but is incomplete, imprecise, or captures only part of the reference meaning
labels.incorrect: prediction contradicts the references or answers a different aspect of the question than what was asked
labels.nonsensical: prediction is self-contradictory, tautological (restates the question), or completely off-topic
labels.ambiguous_gt: the 5 references themselves disagree enough that no judgment is possible without the image
